description: Reproducible chart values, units, source URLs, periods, and interpretation. Calculated illustrations are explicitly identified.

charts.title: Agentic AI: experimentation and scaling
labels: Scaling in at least one function
charts.method: Reported organizational adoption; 1,993 respondents in 105 nations, GDP-weighted. Scaling means at least one function, not enterprise-wide deployment. Historical self-reported survey data; not a 2026 adoption estimate.
charts.source_name: McKinsey, State of AI 2025: survey and methodology

charts.title: Availability targets in a 30-day month
charts.method: Minutes = 43,200 × (1 − availability fraction). This is time-based target arithmetic, following Google SRE, not observed outages, a provider SLA, or a prediction. Contractual exclusions and real service measurements may differ.

charts.title: Third-party involvement in reported breaches
charts.period: Verizon 2025 DBIR comparison with prior report
charts.method: Verizon reports roughly 15% previously and 30% in the 2025 edition. Third parties cover broader supplier relationships, not only website plugins. Different report incident sets; not an individual website’s probability of compromise.

charts.title: Traditional Google result clicks in Pew’s sample
charts.unit: Visits followed by a traditional result click (%)
charts.period: US browsing: March 2025; results reconstructed in April
charts.method: 900 US adults; 68,879 unique Google searches. Search results were reconstructed 7–17 April 2025. The comparison is observational, not a causal estimate of traffic loss or revenue impact.
charts.source_name: Pew Research Center: Google AI summaries, 22 July 2025

charts.title: Common detected homepage accessibility barriers
charts.unit: Sampled homepages with the detected issue (%)
charts.method: Automated WAVE evaluation of one million homepages selected using the Tranco ranking. Issue categories overlap and do not sum to 100%. Automated findings cover only part of accessibility; no detected error does not prove conformance.
charts.source_name: WebAIM Million: February 2025 evaluation and methodology

charts.title: Conversion improvements reported in a speed study
charts.method: Historical four-week mobile-site study across selected brands in Europe and the US, commissioned by Google. Reported association with a 0.1-second natural site-speed improvement; not percentage points, a causal guarantee, or an LCP/INP forecast.

charts.title: Evaluation timelines in two software buyer groups
charts.unit: Respondents within each separately defined group (%)
charts.method: 3,500 software purchasers in nine countries. Bars use different buyer groups and different time bands; they are not complementary shares. Observational survey association cannot show that a shorter evaluation causes success. Capterra is a commercial software marketplace.
charts.source_name: Capterra: 2025 Tech Trends report and survey methodology
